# The toslib JNI library for Android (libnative-lib.so), built per ABI by
# build.sh, and its Java API (src/org/tos/toslib/TosApi.java), generated by a
# host build of this project (target prepare_cross_compiling). A host build also
# produces libnative-lib for the host, which test/android/ smoke-tests in a JVM.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16 FATAL_ERROR)

project(TOS_ANDROID VERSION 0.5 LANGUAGES C CXX)

option(TOSLIB_ENABLE_JNI "Enable JNI-compatible TosLib API" ON)

string(APPEND CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS " -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-deprecated-declarations -fno-omit-frame-pointer -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections")
if (NOT ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} MATCHES "Darwin")
  string(APPEND CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS " -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL")
endif()

add_library(native-lib SHARED native-lib.cpp)

set(TOS_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..)
add_subdirectory(${TOS_DIR} tos EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
target_link_libraries(native-lib toslib)

set(TOSLIB_API_JAVA_PACKAGE "org/tos/toslib")
target_compile_definitions(native-lib PRIVATE PACKAGE_NAME="${TOSLIB_API_JAVA_PACKAGE}")

if (NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  set(TOSLIB_API_JAVA_PATH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/)
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${TOSLIB_API_JAVA_PATH}${TOSLIB_API_JAVA_PACKAGE})
  set(TOSLIB_API_TLO_PATH ${TOS_DIR}/tl/generate/scheme/toslib_api.tlo)
  add_custom_target(tl_generate_java
    COMMAND toslib_generate_java_api TosApi ${TOSLIB_API_TLO_PATH} ${TOSLIB_API_JAVA_PATH} ${TOSLIB_API_JAVA_PACKAGE}
    COMMENT "Generate the Java toslib API"
    DEPENDS toslib_generate_java_api ${TOSLIB_API_TLO_PATH}
  )
  add_dependencies(prepare_cross_compiling tl_generate_java)
endif()
